verdict.rationale: Warp is primarily an agent product, where an MCP server role would normally not apply. However, its homepage says the Oz agent platform offers "API, CLI, SDK and MCP" as platform surfaces, which suggests a first-party MCP interface other agents could connect to. That single line is thin and ambiguous, and every other MCP mention in the pack describes Warp acting as an MCP client, which earns no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a Warp-hosted or local MCP server (endpoint or serve command, exposed tools, auth/setup), and hands-on or independent corroboration.
